description: Sri Lanka Customs - Notify the Rates of Exchange effective from 16.07.2018 to 22.07.2018 effective from 16.07.2018 to 22.07.2018
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and specifically sets new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel, organizational, or other specialized category.
